craft_notes: Sthāyin: asymmetry — she feeds, he does not. Rows: interpenetration then verdict. Rejected: balancing the asymmetry — killed: asymmetry is the doctrine. Read aloud: turn, then cut.

lines: From self in other, other in self — where calm meets else,
of the two, by two-naturedness — she, power, risen even so, feeds the outflow on;
l4.sanskrit_cite: svātmānyonyāveśāt śāntānyatve dvayor dvayātmatvāt śaktis tu tadvad uditāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ puṣṇāti no tadvān
